meta.version: 2026-07 ordering (same eight hues/steps as predecessor, re-ordered)
notes: Every hex comes from palette.md. null = palette.md gives no value; never invent one.
Categorical slot order is the CVD-safety mechanism: assign in sequence, never cycle, never re-order.

Adjacent pairlist (stacks/bars/lines) validates all eight slots in both modes; all-pairs forms (scatter/bubble/choropleth/small multiples) cap at the first three slots, fold the rest to Other or facet.
Light mode slots 3, 4, 5 (aqua, yellow, magenta) sit below 3:1 on the light surface: relief rule - ship direct labels or the table view.

gray = the de-emphasis gray for emphasis charts (1 hue + gray). palette.md documents no separate value, so it is the Muted (axis/labels) ink in both modes: the only documented neutral clearing 3:1 on both surfaces (3.50 light, 4.85 dark) while staying the most recessive. Highlight in series-1: aqua, magenta and red fall under the CVD floor against it.

texture.ink: tone-on-tone (a darker step of the fill's own ramp)

font.tabular_nums: columns that must align only (table rows, axis ticks); hero figures use proportional
